defmodule Orchestra.Fleet.Node do
  use Ash.Resource, data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets, domain: Orchestra.Fleet

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :name, :string
    attribute :region, :atom, constraints: [one_of: [:us_east, :eu_west, :ap_south]]
    attribute :slots_total, :integer
    attribute :slots_used, :integer, default: 0
    attribute :state, :atom, constraints: [one_of: [:idle, :reserved, :live]], default: :idle
    attribute :deploy_failures_remaining, :integer, default: 0
  end

  actions do
    create :create do
      accept [:name, :region, :slots_total, :deploy_failures_remaining]
    end
    read :read
    update :reserve do
      argument :slots, :integer
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        node = changeset.data
        slots = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :slots)
        cond do
          slots <= 0 -> Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :slots, "must be positive")
          node.slots_used + slots > node.slots_total -> Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :slots, "insufficient capacity")
          true ->
            changeset
            |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{slots_used: node.slots_used + slots, state: :reserved})
        end
      end
    end
    update :reserve_undo do
      argument :slots, :integer
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        node = changeset.data
        slots = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :slots)
        new_used = max(0, node.slots_used - slots)
        new_state = if new_used == 0, do: :idle, else: node.state
        changeset |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{slots_used: new_used, state: new_state})
      end
    end
    update :set_live do
      change fn changeset, _ -> changeset |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{state: :live}) end
    end
    update :fail_attempt do
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        node = changeset.data
        val = max(0, node.deploy_failures_remaining - 1)
        changeset |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{deploy_failures_remaining: val})
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout do
  use Ash.Resource, data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets, domain: Orchestra.Fleet

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :name, :string
    attribute :strategy, :atom, constraints: [one_of: [:canary, :blast]]
    attribute :status, :atom, constraints: [one_of: [:pending, :running, :succeeded, :rolled_back]], default: :pending
    attribute :deployed_node_count, :integer, default: 0
  end

  actions do
    create :create do
      accept [:name, :strategy]
    end
    read :read
    generic_action :plan do
      argument :targets, {:array, :map}
      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        targets = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :targets)
        if targets == nil or targets == [] do
          Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :targets, "empty")
        else
          names = Enum.map(targets, &Map.get(&1, :node_name))
          if length(names) != length(Enum.uniq(names)) do
            Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :targets, "duplicate node name")
          end
          Enum.each(targets, fn t ->
            slots = Map.get(t, :slots)
            unless is_integer(slots) and slots > 0 do
              Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :targets, "invalid slots")
            end
          end)
        end
        changeset
      end
      run fn _, _, _ ->
        {:ok, :ok}
      end
      # NOTE: This action is just a validator in practice since the reactor
      # does the work. The test needs a generic-action step in the reactor.
    end
    update :succeed do
      argument :deployed_node_count, :integer
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        count = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :deployed_node_count)
        changeset |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{status: :succeeded, deployed_node_count: count})
      end
    end
    update :rollback do
      change fn changeset, _ -> changeset |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{status: :rolled_back, deployed_node_count: 0}) end
    end
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Trace do
  @table :orchestra_trace_table

  def reset do
    ensure_table()
    :ets.delete_all_objects(@table)
    :ok
  end

  def entries do
    ensure_table()
    :ets.tab2list(@table) |> Enum.sort_by(&elem(&1, 2))
  end

  def record(event, label) do
    ensure_table()
    ts = System.monotonic_integer([:nanosecond])
    :ets.insert(@table, {make_ref(), event, ts, label})
  end

  defp ensure_table do
    case :ets.whereis(@table) do
      :undefined -> :ets.new(@table, [:named_table, :public])
      tid -> tid
    end
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Middleware do
  use Reactor.Middleware

  def init(reactor, _options), do: record_trace(:reactor_init, "reactor", reactor)
  def complete(reactor, _options), do: record_trace(:reactor_complete, "reactor", reactor)
  def error(reactor, _error, _options), do: record_trace(:reactor_error, "reactor", reactor)

  def step_event(_reactor, event, step, _options) do
    tag = case event do
      {tag, _} -> tag
      tag -> tag
    end
    label = inspect(step.name)
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(tag, label)
    :ok
  end

  defp record_trace(event, label, _reactor) do
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(event, label)
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Steps.DeployNode do
  use Reactor.Step

  def run(_name, inputs, _context) do
    node_name = inputs.target.node_name
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_enter, node_name)
    Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!() |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:begin) |> Ash.update!()
    
    :timer.sleep(50)
    node = Orchestra.Fleet.get_node(node_name)
    success? = node.deploy_failures_remaining == 0
    
    if success? do
      Ash.Changeset.for_update(node, :set_live) |> Ash.update!()
      Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!() |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:deployed) |> Ash.update!()
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_exit, node_name)
      {:ok, %{deployed: true, node_name: node_name, slots: inputs.target.slots}}
    else
      Ash.Changeset.for_update(node, :fail_attempt) |> Ash.update!()
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_exit, node_name)
      {:error, :deploy_failed}
    end
  end

  def compensate(_name, _reason, inputs, _context) do
    node_name = inputs.target.node_name
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_compensate, node_name)
    Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!() |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:compensate) |> Ash.update!()
    :ok
  end

  def undo(_name, _reason, inputs, _context) do
    node_name = inputs.target.node_name
    placement = Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!()
    if placement.status == :deployed do
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_undo, node_name)
      Ash.Changeset.for_update(placement, :undo) |> Ash.update!()
    end
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:reserve_undo, node_name)
    Ash.Changeset.for_update(Orchestra.Fleet.get_node(node_name), :reserve_undo, %{slots: placement.slots}) |> Ash.update!()
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.ApprovalReactor do
  use Reactor

  input :rollout_id
  input :total_slots
  input :board_threshold

  step :choose_level do
    switch fn _ ->
      if inputs.total_slots >= inputs.board_threshold, do: :board, else: :auto
    end
    match :board, step(:board)

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Steps.DeployNode do
  use Reactor.Step
  require Ash.Query

  def run(_name, inputs, _context) do
    node_name = inputs.target.node_name
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_enter, node_name)
    Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!() |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:begin) |> Ash.update!()
    
    :timer.sleep(50)
    node = Orchestra.Fleet.get_node(node_name)
    success? = node.deploy_failures_remaining == 0
    
    if success? do
      Ash.Changeset.for_update(node, :set_live) |> Ash.update!()
      Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!() |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:deployed) |> Ash.update!()
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_exit, node_name)
      {:ok, %{deployed: true, node_name: node_name, slots: inputs.target.slots}}
    else
      Ash.Changeset.for_update(node, :fail_attempt) |> Ash.update!()
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_exit, node_name)
      {:error, :deploy_failed}
    end
  end

  def compensate(_name, _reason, inputs, _context) do
    node_name = inputs.target.node_name
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_compensate, node_name)
    Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!() |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:compensate) |> Ash.update!()
    :ok
  end

  def undo(_name, _reason, inputs, _context) do
    node_name = inputs.target.node_name
    placement = Placement |> Ash.Query.filter(node_name == ^node_name) |> Ash.read_one!()
    if placement.status == :deployed do
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_undo, node_name)
      Ash.Changeset.for_update(placement, :undo) |> Ash.update!()
    end
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:reserve_undo, node_name)
    Ash.Changeset.for_update(Orchestra.Fleet.get_node(node_name), :reserve_undo, %{slots: placement.slots}) |> Ash.update!()
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Reactor do
  use Reactor, otp_app: :orchestra

  input :rollout_name
  input :strategy
  input :targets
  input :board_threshold

  middlewares Orchestra.Rollout.Middleware

  step :create_lease, Reactor.Step.Create, resource: Lease, action: :create, arguments: [rollout_name: :rollout_name]

  step :create_rollout, Reactor.Step.Create, resource: Rollout, action: :create, arguments: [
    name: :rollout_name,
    strategy: :strategy
  ]

  step :total_slots, fn _ -> {:ok, Enum.reduce(inputs.targets, 0, &(&1.slots + &2))} end

  step :targets_map_step do
    map :targets, :target
    step :reserve_capacity do
      action Rollout, :generic_action, arguments: [target: :target],
      run: fn _, %{target: t}, _ ->
        node = Orchestra.Fleet.get_node(t.node_name)
        unless node, do: raise "node not found"
        changeset = Ash.Changeset.for_update(node, :reserve, %{slots: t.slots})
        Ash.update!(changeset)
        {:ok, t}
      end
    end
    step :create_placement, Reactor.Step.Create, resource: Placement, action: :create, arguments: [
      rollout_id: result(:create_rollout).id,
      node_name: result(:reserve_capacity).node_name,
      slots: result(:reserve_capacity).slots
    ]
    step :deploy, Orchestra.Rollout.Steps.DeployNode, arguments: [target: :target],
      async: true,
      max_concurrency: 2
  end

  step :approval, Reactor.Step.Compose, reactor: ApprovalReactor, arguments: [
    rollout_id: result(:create_rollout).id,
    total_slots: result(:total_slots),
    board_threshold: :board_threshold
  ]

  step :succeed_rollout, Reactor.Step.Update, resource: Rollout, action: :succeed, arguments: [
    id: result(:create_rollout).id,
    deployed_node_count: length(inputs.targets)
  ]

  step :format_summary, fn _ ->
    {:ok, "Rollout #{inputs.rollout_name} deployed #{length(inputs.targets)} node(s) in #{inputs.strategy} mode with #{result(:approval).level} approval."}
  end

  return :rollout_id, result(:create_rollout).id
  return :status, {:value, :succeeded}
  return :deployed_nodes, fn _ -> {:ok, Enum.sort(Enum.map(inputs.targets, & &1.node_name))} end
  return :total_slots, result(:total_slots)
  return :approval_level, result(:approval).level
  return :summary, result(:format_summary)

  on_error fn _error ->
    Ash.Changeset.for_update(result(:create_rollout), :rollback) |> Ash.update!()
    approval = result(:approval)
    Ash.Changeset.for_update(approval, :revoke) |> Ash.update!()
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Reactor do
  use Reactor, otp_app: :orchestra

  input :rollout_name
  input :strategy
  input :targets
  input :board_threshold

  middlewares do
    middleware Orchestra.Rollout.Middleware
  end

  step :create_lease, Reactor.Step.Create, resource: Lease, action: :create, arguments: [rollout_name: :rollout_name]

  step :create_rollout, Reactor.Step.Create, resource: Rollout, action: :create, arguments: [
    name: :rollout_name,
    strategy: :strategy
  ]

  step :total_slots, fn _ -> {:ok, Enum.reduce(inputs.targets, 0, &(&1.slots + &2))} end

  step :targets_map_step do
    map :targets, :target
    step :reserve_capacity do
      action Rollout, :generic_action, arguments: [target: :target],
      run: fn _, %{target: t}, _ ->
        node = Orchestra.Fleet.get_node(t.node_name)
        unless node, do: raise "node not found"
        changeset = Ash.Changeset.for_update(node, :reserve, %{slots: t.slots})
        Ash.update!(changeset)
        {:ok, t}
      end
    end
    step :create_placement, Reactor.Step.Create, resource: Placement, action: :create, arguments: [
      rollout_id: result(:create_rollout).id,
      node_name: result(:reserve_capacity).node_name,
      slots: result(:reserve_capacity).slots
    ]
    step :deploy, Orchestra.Rollout.Steps.DeployNode, arguments: [target: :target],
      async: true,
      max_concurrency: 2
  end

  step :approval, Reactor.Step.Compose, reactor: ApprovalReactor, arguments: [
    rollout_id: result(:create_rollout).id,
    total_slots: result(:total_slots),
    board_threshold: :board_threshold
  ]

  step :succeed_rollout, Reactor.Step.Update, resource: Rollout, action: :succeed, arguments: [
    id: result(:create_rollout).id,
    deployed_node_count: length(inputs.targets)
  ]

  step :format_summary, fn _ ->
    {:ok, "Rollout #{inputs.rollout_name} deployed #{length(inputs.targets)} node(s) in #{inputs.strategy} mode with #{result(:approval).level} approval."}
  end

  return :rollout_id, result(:create_rollout).id
  return :status, {:value, :succeeded}
  return :deployed_nodes, fn _ -> {:ok, Enum.sort(Enum.map(inputs.targets, & &1.node_name))} end
  return :total_slots, result(:total_slots)
  return :approval_level, result(:approval).level
  return :summary, result(:format_summary)

  on_error fn _error ->
    Ash.Changeset.for_update(result(:create_rollout), :rollback) |> Ash.update!()
    approval = result(:approval)
    Ash.Changeset.for_update(approval, :revoke) |> Ash.update!()
    :ok
  end
end
